resources.string: Lets Shield see what is on screen so it can close adult content inside apps and stop the protection being switched off. Screen contents are checked on the device and never stored or sent anywhere.
Prevents Shield from being uninstalled without the cooling-off period and your accountability partner\'s approval.
Turning this off removes the uninstall protection you set up. Your accountability partner will be told. If you are struggling right now, open Shield and use the urge support screen instead.
The permanent notice showing that filtering is active. Android requires this to keep the filter running.
Warnings when protection is weakened or tampered with.
Filtering is PAUSED — unlock window is open
The filter is no longer running. Open Shield to turn it back on.
Shield: the content filter was switched off or replaced by another VPN. The device is currently unprotected.
Shield: the on-screen guard was switched off. In-app blocking and tamper protection are not working.
